14.name: Hyper Misao Produce ~HYPE!4~
14.overview:
★ Kitazawa Town Hall • Tokyo, Japan ★

Chika Nanase trains by herself during a night at the Kanda Myōjin shrine in Tokyo, and after finishing her prayer, she finds Hyper Misao's mask on the ground in front of her. Next thing she knows, she is pulled into another world - instead of Kanda Myōjin, Nanase is now in a realm called Can Do Myōjin! Surprisingly emotional shenanigans ensue.

overview: Tokyo Joshi Pro-Wrestling, often abbreviated to TJP or TJPW, is a Japanese joshi puroresu or women's professional wrestling promotion founded in 2012 as a sister promotion of DDT Pro-Wrestling. Initially running alongside other shows such as live music and other idol performances, it became its own fully fledged promotion starting on February 28, 2015.
